Name: _comment
_src: PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR PRODUCTION. Rivals board, card and Sniff display data (design/ux/key-screens.md §2-§4, Nemesis §3.6, §3.13, §3.17). Display only: nothing here changes a cat. Words are UX/Narrative placeholders.

Name: scenes
_src: key-screens §2.2: six scenes in town-climbing order (Lane -> Arcade -> Shiosai -> Summit, then Outsiders, then the Bell); uphill scenes are hazed silhouettes with 'Further up the hill.'

Name: anchors
_src: key-screens §2.3: depth = fixed role (Boss on the perch, Captains on the steps, Toughs on the path, Roamers on a wall at the side), within a tier in discovery order from the centre line out; unmet cats wait in the shade along the walls (not on their role spot); roaming Boss walks out; a Boss in truce sits beside the perch (§2.9); Outsiders at the bus stop; Bell: Mikan on the truck roof, Crew on the bed

Name: role_tags
_src: key-screens §2.4 tag formats. ASSUMPTION: a gang Roamer reads 'Roamer · word' (the table lists Roamer only under Outsiders)

Name: pictograms
_src: key-screens §3.2: Grudge hackles smooth -> bristled -> arched -> storm, Regard ears back -> level -> forward -> nose-out, 4 steps, no numbers. ASSUMPTION: quartile bands (75 matches Bitter and Friend)

Name: mark_priority
_src: key-screens §2.5: at rest <= 1 drawn mark per cat, storm > steam puffs > truce sprig > grumble cloud > head plaster

Name: tags
_src: key-screens §2.7 / OR-04: Gang/Boss by arrows only; paper tags only for the rare ties, <= 3 in the scene, Rival > Kin > Old Boss/Old Gang; a tie in another scene is one chip under that scene's tab; both cats must be discovered

Name: card_text

value.not_met: Not met yet. Sniff it out: hold Whisker Sense near it.
value.boss_anger: Angry at your marks in his Lane. Spent in his next fight.
boss_anger_rival_card: Rises when you over-mark or counter-spray in the Lane. Cools each night.
Next fight with him: {fired}. Spent after his next fight.

fired.Seething: Fired Up for a long while

_src: key-screens §2.8 card context lines, §3.2 anger lines, Truce line, legend stamp

Name: history_lines

value.FLED: Faster than a kitten. Remember that.
value.ROUTED_OWN: You knocked me off my own post.
value.LICK_IN: I flattened you. Your crew won it.
value.SLIPPED_AWAY: Slipped off while you weren't looking.
value.TITLE: They call me {title} now.

_src: key-screens §2.8 item 4 / §3.2 History: one line in the cat's own voice from its OWN Memory (G8), <= 60 characters, with the day. Placeholders; Narrative words them

Name: sniff_cards

boss_window.title: The big wall's come down.
boss_window.line: {name} has come down off the walls.

anger.title: The big wall is seething.
anger.line: Angry at your marks in his Lane.

arc_lead.title: A fresh mark
arc_lead.line: {name}'s fresh mark over his own post.
